name: devops-engineer
description: ⚠️ ALWAYS load `docker-skill.md` FIRST when ANY container/Docker work begins, `gameci-unity.md` when ANY Unity CI work begins, `terraform-skill.md` when ANY Terraform/OpenTofu/IaC work begins, `gitops-skill.md` when ANY GitOps/ArgoCD/Flux/SOPS/OTel-Collector/Trivy-gating work begins, and `references/opensource-release-pipeline.md` when ANY work turns private/client code into a PUBLIC repo (fork/sanitize/package/publish). These are the most-forgotten files. DevOps Engineer for Solaris - CI/CD pipelines (GitHub Actions primary + GitLab + CircleCI + Bitrise + Codemagic), IaC (Terraform + OpenTofu + Pulumi + CDK with Anton Babenko's anti-hallucination playbook + module structure template + state management + OIDC CI auth + native Terraform test + OpenTofu migration), cloud deployment (AWS/GCP/Azure/Vercel/Railway/Fly.io), Kubernetes + Docker, secrets management, observability (metrics/logs/traces/errors/uptime), release management (blue-green/canary/feature flags), incident response, cost optimization. v0.3.0 absorbed: wrsmith108/docker-the coding agent-skill + RchGrav/the coding agentbox + GameCI. v0.4.0 adds: antonbabenko/terraform-skill (1.7K stars Apache 2.0, by terraform-aws-modules maintainer - Terraform Registry's most-downloaded modules author). Includes legacy FTP/SFTP playbook for shared-host PHP/WP clients. ftp-deploy now lives as GIG #2 (solaris/gigs/ftp-deploy/) - cross-referenced for the deploy run; migration-architect now lives as a takeover-chain reference under delivery-lead. devops-engineer keeps its from-first-principles legacy-FTP section. (Doctrine retired 2026-06-04.) v0.7.0 (2026-06-13) adds gitops-skill.md: ArgoCD (22.9k, Apache-2.0) + Flux (8.2k, Apache-2.0) GitOps methodology, SOPS (MPL-2.0, methodology-only) secrets-in-git, OpenTelemetry Collector (Apache-2.0) telemetry pipeline, and Trivy (36.4k, Apache-2.0) security gating with the 2026 supply-chain SHA-pin warning. v0.8.0 (2026-06-14) adds references/opensource-release-pipeline.md: ECC (affaan-m/ECC, MIT) open-source release/sanitization methodology (methodology-only) - fork (strip secrets+history+internal refs) -> independent sanitize audit -> package (license/README/AGENTS.md/CI) -> human publish checklist. Distinct from deploy CI/CD and GitOps CD.

METHODOLOGY (2026-06-13 depth pass) - GitOps/secrets/telemetry/scanning, lifted into gitops-skill.md (no source vendored): argoproj/argo-cd (22.9k★, Apache-2.0, v3.4.2 2026-05-12) + fluxcd/flux2 (8.2k★, Apache-2.0, v2.8.8 2026-05-20) - GitOps CD Application/ApplicationSet + Kustomization, sync policy, Argo-vs-Flux selection; getsops/sops (~22k★, MPL-2.0 [FLAGGED weak-copyleft - methodology referenced, no code vendored, self-host note included]) - secrets-in-git encryption discipline; open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector (7.1k★, Apache-2.0) - receivers/processors/exporters telemetry pipeline; aquasecurity/trivy (36.4k★, Apache-2.0, v0.71.0 2026-06-01) - vuln+secret+misconfig SARIF gating + 2026 supply-chain SHA-pin warning. Gate-0: GitOps/SOPS/OTel-Collector all name-drop-only or absent (net-new methodology); Trivy was name-dropped in tool lists but had no config/gating/SHA-pin (methodology net-new).

METHODOLOGY (2026-06-14 depth pass) - Open-source release/sanitization pipeline, lifted into references/opensource-release-pipeline.md (no source vendored): affaan-m/ECC (MIT) opensource-pipeline skill + opensource-forker/sanitizer/packager staged agents - 3-gate public-release discipline (fork: strip secrets+parameterize internal refs+fresh git history -> sanitize: independent read-only audit, any CRITICAL=FAIL -> package: LICENSE/README/AGENTS.md/setup.sh/CONTRIBUTING/CI) + Stage-4 human publish checklist. This is a release/sanitization pipeline, distinct from the deploy CI/CD (SKILL.md) and from GitOps CD (gitops-skill.md). Gate-0: no open-source-release/sanitization/forker content existed in devops-engineer (gitops-skill.md covers GitOps CD, not public-release sanitization) - net-new methodology. No ECC code/regex/agent files bundled; SHA-pin CI carried into the publish checklist; memory scoped devops/opensource-release/<project>.

ftp-deploy (Shai's former gig, folded 2026-06-14): git-to-live FTP/FTPS deploy via GitHub Actions (SamKirkland/FTP-Deploy-Action, SHA-pinned), pre-deploy checks, version tagging, post-deploy verify. Reclassified gig->devops deploy skill per Shai. -> ftp-git-deploy.md

CONNECT 2026-06-14: coollabsio/coolify (Apache-2.0, ~57k stars) - open-source self-hostable PaaS (Heroku/Vercel/Netlify alternative). Our default self-host deploy platform + the engine behind a managed-hosting revenue line: git/Docker app deploys, databases, auto-TLS, previews, backups, multi-server/multi-tenant management on infra we control. Documented in rules.md (Self-host PaaS / managed-hosting platform). Apache-2.0 = permissive: self-host + hosting-as-a-service + modify freely, no copyleft trigger. Host-installed; auto-deploy does NOT install it. Productization is Shai's business decision.

DEPTH 2026-06-14 v0.11.0 (toolchain pass): dagger/dagger (Apache-2.0, ~15.7k stars, created by Solomon Hykes + original Docker team) + jdx/mise (MIT, ~12.3k stars, active rel 2026.x). Both OSI-permissive, credible, well-starred, active. METHODOLOGY/TOOLCHAIN ONLY, no code bundled -> references/dagger-mise-toolchain.md. Dagger = programmable containerized CI engine: pipelines as code (Go/Python/TS SDKs) running identically locally and in any CI, content-cached host-clean steps, incremental adoption inside the existing GitHub Actions trigger (dagger call), digest/SHA pinning + Dagger secret types, boundary vs IaC/GitOps. mise = single declarative manager for tool versions + per-dir env + project tasks (mise.toml), asdf-compatible, exact-version pinning, self-documenting tasks, CI+local parity, env-not-secrets discipline, composes with Docker/Dagger. Gate-0: CI doctrine was 100% YAML-runner-shaped (GH Actions/GitLab/CircleCI/Bitrise/Codemagic) with no programmable/containerized pipeline engine and no run-CI-locally story; no tool/runtime version manager existed (no mise/asdf/.tool-versions). Dagger+mise = 0 hits. Net-new. OpenTofu was a candidate this pass but REJECTED as a duplicate: terraform-skill.md already covers it (OpenTofu-vs-Terraform section, default-to-OpenTofu, MPL-2.0, migration path). Tools host-installed/project-pinned; CI invocations stay SHA-pinned; no upstream code vendored; no em-dashes.
